svg.aria-label: Maria, developer in Barakaldo, Spain. A pixel art girl codes on her laptop with a wolf pup sitting beside her, next to a terminal that runs docker compose up maria and starts her services: frontend with Angular, React and Ionic; backend with Java, Spring Boot and Python; mobile with Ionic, React Native and Swift; devops with Docker, Kubernetes and GitHub Actions; and pack: looking for a team, available.
